attchmntText: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) taken or orders passed
voiceSummary: Ethos Limited received two Orders-in-Appeal from the Commissioner of CGST, Chandigarh, dated November 19, 2026, on November 20, 2026. The orders confirm a total tax demand of 117.58 crore rupees, comprising 87.94 crore rupees for July 2017 to March 2020 and 29.64 crore rupees for April 2020 to March 2021. Additional standalone interest of 0.22 crore rupees is also confirmed. The company has set aside 1.02 crore rupees and 0.19 crore rupees in its favor under the respective orders. Approximately 112.22 crore rupees of the confirmed demand relates to GST on customer advances, which the company argues has already been discharged. Ethos Limited states it will pursue legal remedies before competent judicial forums and asserts that the orders will not have a material impact on its financial or operational activities.

attchmntText: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Ethos Limited filed a notice with BSE and NSE regarding the publication of newspaper clippings for the extract of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The publication appeared in The Financial Express and Himachal Times on November 14, 2026. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 30 and Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Priya Grover, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the letter on behalf of Ethos Limited.

Ethos Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Rights Issue for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Crisil Ratings Limited issued the report. The Rights Issue size was up to Rs 40,990.50 lakh. Proceeds were utilized for working capital and issue expenses. Rs 20,978.96 lakh was utilized. Rs 20,011.54 lakh remains unutilized. Unutilized funds are invested in fixed deposits with HDFC Bank. The return on investment is 6.90 percent. There were no deviations from the objects disclosed in the Offer Document. The company confirmed that general corporate purposes funds will be utilized in subsequent quarters.
